Exterior Pest Protection

Spiders, Insects & Wood-Boring Bees — Kept Outside

Every spring in Utah, carpenter bees chew perfectly round holes into fences, decks, fascia boards, and eaves — and once they start, they come back year after year. Spiders and crawling insects push inside as the weather shifts.

Kesler Lawn And Pest Control, LLC. treats the outside of your home so pests never make it in: foundation spider barriers in spring, summer, and fall, plus year-round insect prevention on the lawn.

  • Foundation barrier stops spiders & insects at the entry points
  • Timed with your lawn visits — no extra appointments needed
  • Guaranteed results, or we make it right
